links.outcome: Change in IPSS/OABSS scoring error between successive ChatGPT model generations on local narratives
links.effect: IPSS MAE/RMSE 4.88/6.34 (4o) vs 4.92/7.01 (5.1); OABSS 1.88/2.76 vs 2.03/2.93; no significant differences between models
links.quote: For IPSS prediction, MAE/RMSE were 4.88/6.34 for ChatGPT-4o and 4.92/7.01 for ChatGPT-5.1, with no significant differences between models.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of LLM performance (GPT-4o vs GPT-5.1) for automated symptom score extraction from clinical narratives without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
